title: Stranded band to Minot, North Dakota and Herb Whitfield
summary: Pianist Terry hires him and the bassist for a restaurant job in Minot, then Herb Whitfield's hotel band; McGhee begins writing for that band.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: What year are we in now?
Oh, this would have to be around '36 or '37,

somewhere along there. Anyway, a guy named Terry, who played piano, came to Grand Rapids to get some musicians. He heard the band was stranded there, and he came to pick up some musicians, because he had a job working at some restaurant in Minot, North Dakota. And he hired me and the bass player...
So now we're in Grand Rapids. This guy Terry, the piano player, came...
Yeah, he came and got us.

Yeah, for Minot. So anyway, we went to Minor, and we worked there for a while. And there was another band there named Herb Whitfield. He had a group working at a hotel. After this gig that Terry had folded, he sounded me and the bass player to come work with him, which we did. You know, naturally, you've got to keep working, and when you're poor you can't say no to no job. So we went on down there, and we started to work there. And I learned how to write for the... I knew the trumpet and tenor, I'd been writing music, so I started writing for that band. And everybody liked the tunes that I was writing, so I kept it up.
